mean_level_vs_replication_level_explanat: Mean-level cell comparisons average over 100 replications before deciding win/loss, which cancels many threshold decision errors; replication-level comparisons decide win/loss per replicate and reveal that hard-threshold selector choices often miss the per-rep best fixed estimator even when the cell mean remains near best.
scope: CPU/local deterministic diagnostic artifact generation from the e010 script/spec; no new experiment was submitted and no selector variant was tested.
